senses.sense_definition: To behave playfully towards someone to show romantic or sexual interest.

examples.text: They spent the entire evening talking and laughing together as they <w>flirted</w>.

es.target_lang_sense_clarification: coquetear o buscar un acercamiento amoroso

senses.sense_definition: An informal name for a group of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron subvariants, including KP.2 and KP.1.1.

examples.text: Scientists noted that the <w>FLiRT</w> lineage had acquired specific spike protein mutations.

traits.comment: Informal scientific acronym and popular moniker

target_lang_definitions.es: Nombre informal de un grupo de subvariantes de la cepa ómicron del SARS-CoV-2.
